biography.plain_text: Geert Pepping was a Dutch shipowner who helped develop Seatrade into a major refrigerated shipping group. Bringing family vessels and fruit-trade expertise into the business, he became a partner and later its main owner. After stepping back from daily management, he supported entrepreneurial succession as a founding investor in All Interests Aligned.

long_biography.plain_text:
Geert Pepping approached the shipping business with a captain's knowledge of how vessels worked. At Seatrade, he and Henk Schuur developed a design that increased pallet capacity without exceeding the specified tonnage. When the company acquired another operator's fleet, he sold ships that were less suitable for pallets or consumed too much fuel, keeping those better suited to the trade.

His commercial habits also reflected an earlier apprenticeship under shipowner Jan Dammers. Working when communications were charged by the word, Pepping learned to strip messages down to their essentials. He retained that preference for short emails and texts long after technology had changed the cost of sending them.
